assets.name: Drawbridge Key
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one new Moticos matching-game higher-tier sprite and earned postcard illustration, called Drawbridge Key; do not draw the name.
Input images are style and family references, not edit targets: image 1 is the exact gold Round Key; image 2 is the exact Frond Key. Create one new original evolution in the same handmade cut-paper world.
Subject: a large mustard-gold antique key lies horizontally across the lower half, open round bow clearly on the left, thick shaft and two bold downward teeth clearly on the right. The entire recognizable key is the dominant object, not a tiny accessory. Above its shaft, a little impossible drawbridge unfolds as TWO broad angular cream paper bridge leaves with coral-red folded undersides, rising and lowering in a simple zigzag over the shaft. No rails or posts. One short dark teal frond with only four broad leaves grows from the key near the teeth. The new silhouette is a wide low gold key with a striking angular folded bridge rising in its middle. Key bow opening remains completely transparent and uncluttered. The cream paper bridge is compact, no more than half the key's width. Readable as a strong key family at 50px.
Style/medium: precisely match references' flat handcrafted layered colored paper collage, fine visible natural paper grain, slightly irregular crisp hand-cut edges, shallow overlap only. Gold, cream, coral, dark teal palette. Large simple shapes, charming surreal object, no realistic materials.
Composition: single centered square isolated cutout, full object visible, central 82% of frame with generous clear margin. Actual transparent alpha background and all internal openings transparent. No drawn backdrop.
Avoid: letters, numerals, symbols, labels, badges, borders, background cards, scenes, shadows on the background, gradients, photography, 3D, garden gates, arches, houses, greenhouses, birds, extra keys, tiny decoration, multiple images.
